blueprints.descricao: An app for the courier to receive orders, follow the route and confirm the delivery.
blueprints.obs: Fictional example. Goals: first version for the pilot in November; no real customer data.

acoes.obs:
Goal: validate the flow with three couriers before writing production code.
Deliverable: a clickable prototype with the order, route and confirmation screens.

planos.descricao:
Scope: order, route and confirmation
Expected result: three approved screens
Validation: review with the operations team

comentarios.texto: Screens delivered and reviewed with operations.

planos.descricao:
Scope: link the screens into a navigable flow
Expected result: a single link to test on a phone
Validation: test with one courier

Scope: a 20-minute session per person
Expected result: a list of adjustments
Validation: a report with the observations

checkpoints.evidencia: Meeting on 12/10: flow approved with no reservations.

acoes.obs:
Goal: a service that receives orders and gives the app the day's list.
Deliverable: endpoints to list, accept and complete an order, with automated tests.
Risks: instability of the maps provider (mitigation: cache the last route).

planos.descricao:
Scope: tables and relationships
Expected result: an approved schema
Validation: migration applied to an empty database

Scope: GET /orders filtered by courier
Expected result: a paginated list
Validation: automated contract test

Scope: POST /orders/{id}/accept
Expected result: the order changes to on route
Validation: the test covers an already accepted order (409)

Scope: photo and time of delivery
Expected result: the order is completed with proof
Validation: test with a 3 MB file

Scope: call examples for each endpoint
Expected result: a published document
Validation: another person runs the examples without help

acoes.obs:
Goal: a version for the pilot, with an order list, route and confirmation.
Depends on the "Orders API" action.

planos.descricao:
Scope: a list screen with refresh
Expected result: the day's list on the phone
Validation: manual test on two devices

planos.texto: Implement the route to the customer
planos.descricao:

Expected result: the route opens when the order is accepted
Validation: field test with one courier

Scope: photo and signature
Expected result: the order is completed on the server
Validation: end-to-end test with the API

blueprints.descricao: A dashboard that shows the office's energy use by room.

planos.texto: Read the meters over the local network

Expected result: readings every minute
Validation: one hour of readings with no failure
